info.description: API for gns3util distributed file storage
info.title: gns3util cluster filestore API

get.description: Returns all backups owned by the caller. Admins see all backups.

post.description: Creates a file record and a backups metadata row atomically, returning a file UUID and upload URL.

get.description: Returns the combined file and backups metadata for the requested UUID.

delete.description: Deletes the backup record, its parent file, and the blob when no other references remain.

patch.description: Patches backups fields (source_node_id, backup_type, is_compressed, is_encrypted, parent_backup_uuid). Requires write permission on the file.

get.description: Returns all buckets accessible to the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new bucket for organizing files

delete.description: Deletes a bucket and all files contained within it

get.description: Returns all files in a specific bucket
Returns all permission entries on a bucket. Requires owner or admin permission.

post.description: Grants read/write/admin permission on a bucket to a user, group, or role.

delete.description: Removes a permission entry from a bucket by permission ID.

post.description: Creates a new upload session and returns a file UUID and upload URL

get.description: Downloads a file with support for range requests (byte-range downloads)

delete.description: Deletes a file and marks blob as deleted

put.description: Uploads file content with resumable upload support via Content-Range header

get.description: Returns all permission entries on a file. Requires owner or admin permission.

post.description: Grants read/write/admin permission on a specific file to a user, group, or role.

delete.description: Removes a permission entry from a file by permission ID.

post.description: Creates a temporary public access token for sharing a file without authentication

get.description: Returns the current byte offset for an in-progress upload (for resumable uploads)

post.description: Triggers execution of a registered background job

get.description:
Returns project files owned by the caller, optionally filtered by project_id query param.
Admins see all project files. The optional ?project_id= filter is applied after access control.

post.description:
Creates a file record and a project_files metadata row atomically.
The fields mirror the options available on the GNS3 project export command.

get.description: Returns the combined file and project_files metadata for the requested UUID.

delete.description: Deletes the project_files record, its parent file, and the blob when no other references remain.

patch.description:
Patches project_files fields (project_name, version_tag, is_read_only, export flags, compression).
Requires write permission on the file.

get.description: Returns all VM images owned by the caller. Admins see all VM images.

post.description: Creates a file record and a vm_images metadata row atomically, returning a file UUID and upload URL.

get.description: Returns the combined file and vm_images metadata for the requested UUID.

delete.description: Deletes the VM image record, its parent file, and the blob when no other references remain.

patch.description: Patches vm_images fields (virt_type, format, vcpus, ram_mb, extra_attributes_json). Requires write permission on the file.

get.description: Downloads a file using a public access token (no authentication required)

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
